top demo/amp.shbench for Cdl
== demo/amp.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  vsch 94717ddd97ca7e87

inst e5eqk2 demopdk:nch3_demo
  at 200 0 R0
  name M1
  bn D
inst qk5fb8 demopdk:nch3_demo
  at 0 0 R0
  name M0
inst xhz9jm demopdk:res3_demo
  at 100 0 R0
  name R0

wire 08qfhs 210 -60 210 -40
wire 2ex4an 10 40 10 60
wire 8yvrke 10 -60 10 -40
wire bcn7zy 150 0 170 0
wire bysbab 100 -50 100 -30
wire kr87hn -50 0 -30 0
wire w4ec9v 210 40 210 60
wire ztbszc 100 30 100 50

label 6f1ya3 210 60 R0 x
label jwkka8 -50 0 R0 g
label kzfr61 10 -60 R0 d
label qcn3hx 100 50 R0 s
label th9hm2 210 -60 R0 d
label vczxc6 150 0 R0 g
label vp1pjb 100 -50 R0 d
label w40wje 10 60 R0 s
== demopdk/nch3_demo.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso demopdk/nch3_demo"
  vibox none
  vsym ee10708a572f0669

pin D inout 10 -40
  vplabel none
pin G in -30 0
  vplabel none
pin S inout 10 40
  vplabel none
pin bsub inout 0 0
  inherit vss

param model demo_nch
  kind string
  doc Model
param w 300n
  unit m
  doc Width
param l 30n
  unit m
  doc Length
param bn S
  kind string
  doc "Bulk node"

impl spice spice
  format spectre "{name} ({D} {G} {S} {bsub}) {model} w={w}"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {bn == \"B\" ? bsub : bn == \"D\" ? D : bn == \"G\" ? G : bn == \"S\" ? S : bn} NDEMO w={w}"
== demopdk/res3_demo.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso demopdk/res3_demo"
  vibox none
  vsym 31c405ff8a572a48

pin in inout 0 -30
  vplabel none
pin out inout 0 30
  vplabel none
pin rsub inout 0 0
  inherit vss

param r 2k
  unit Ohm
  doc R

impl spice spice
  format spectre "{name} ({in} {out} {rsub}) resistor r={r}"
  format cdl "R{name} {in} {out} r={r} $[RDEMO]"
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project

lib demo path demo
lib demopdk path demopdk
